study.question: Does the fixed-angle auxiliary context orientation effect survive replacing row-specific occupied auxiliary outcomes with their task-wise batch prevalences, avoiding the injected label-placement noise of a single permutation?
study.hypothesis: Provisional: prevalence- and prediction-conditioned auxiliary cotangents can retain a meaningful part of the reversed-sign advantage without row-specific occupied outcomes in the orientation-bit source. The r0066 shuffled-label result may combine loss of outcome association with permutation noise. Mean soft targets remove the latter at a fixed recipient graph, allowing a cleaner contrast. This does not assert that all auxiliary labels are unnecessary or that parameter-gradient interference explains AUC.

nearest_work.difference: Direct local predecessor: alternate labels are differentiated at fixed recipient probabilities and seven identity context edges. Replace its occupied-cycle label permutation by occupied-population mean soft targets only for the bit-source VJP. Retain its private objective, true native geometry and native bridge branches.

Current incumbent permutes already-computed auxiliary cotangents, retaining their donor label/feature Jacobians together. The proposal changes training targets at the recipient graph, rather than transporting those existing cotangents.

Archived primary text lines239-283 verifies candidate-conditioned unnormalized activation pooling and BCE. Inherit the adapted pooling/embedding/Dice family; the proposed difference is training-only source attribution, not a new local-activation architecture or exact paper reproduction.

Pinned benchmark primary implementation lines123-170 and204-219 contains action-mask task sequence hubs, categorical/task tokens and iterative aggregation/broadcast. No such new forward block is adopted; freeze the existing product-context model and intervene on a supervised cotangent summary. Implementation inspection is partial, not reproduction.

Only original-paper link/provenance is authorized in this registry; no detailed primary text was supplied for this reference. No originality or equivalence claim is made against the original method or general gradient-surgery literature. Gradient-paper search returned no authorized matches.

study.proposed_difference: Let m_i denote history occupancy and mu_t=sum_i m_i*y_it/max(sum_i m_i,1). Only for the counterfactual auxiliary BCE VJP, set ybar_it=mu_t on occupied rows and ybar_it=y_it on empty rows. At fixed recipient graph BCE VJP is affine in targets, making this the uniform-permutation-average VJP before nonlinear bit extraction, up to FP32 rounding; it is not the average bit. Use its Q pivot sign with the inherited canonical fixed-angle transfer. Cross mean versus true-label bit source with reversed versus aligned external sign. Native true-label cotangents continue to determine the real norm/line/support; true-label BCEs train every private module. All four modules compute the same extra source VJP and differ only in two config/default choices. No learned capacity, inference computation, labels in forward or persistent population state is added.
predictions: Predeclared primary comparisons are mean-negative minus true-negative and mean-positive minus true-positive on full validation click AUC; compare sign gaps D_true=AUC(true-negative)-AUC(true-positive), D_mean=AUC(mean-negative)-AUC(mean-positive), and interaction D_true-D_mean.

Working prediction: D_mean remains positive and exceeds 0.0001, while the reversed mean arm is within 0.0001 AUC of the reversed true-label bridge. The 0.0001 margin is a prospective practical decision threshold, not a significance level; seed and user-cluster uncertainty must accompany any repeated-support claim.

At a common nondegenerate state, the mean source must change Q orientation on some real batches to be informative, while leaving actual transfer radius/support and private gradients unchanged. Equal bits on all observed batches predict an uninformative trajectory contrast.

The two native bridges should replay the same-sign r0066 true-label metrics within demonstrated host reproducibility tolerances, because source-only extra cotangents are ignored by that native branch. Forward/checkpoint parity at fixed weights should hold for all four modules.

All arms retain 32192421 learned parameters as an inherited expectation and identical inference paths; training cost should be close to r0066 one-extra-VJP cost, measured rather than assumed. No claim of an efficiency improvement is predicted.
falsifiers: With verified bit disagreement and equal native support/norms, a repeated mean-negative deficit larger than 0.0001 AUC versus true-negative, or disappearance/reversal of D_mean, rejects the prediction that the mean source preserves the orientation effect at the stated practical margin.
If source bits/actual VJPs do not change, a null AUC result is an ineffective intervention and cannot show row-specific outcomes are unnecessary.

Native bridge drift, private-gradient differences, scalar-loss changes, support/norm mismatch, masked-input dependence, nonfinite derivatives or unexpected learned state invalidate mechanism attribution until resolved within the existing budget.

A single favorable AUC without fixed-state diagnostics, paired new seeds and uncertainty does not establish the mechanism. If mean beats permuted labels but differs from true labels, permutation noise is only a provisional explanation until common-state/trajectory controls discriminate it.
alternative_explanations: Mean-target VJP retains batch prevalence and recipient predictions/Jacobians, plus empty-row labels; actual transfer radius/support and private task learning still use true labels. This is not a test of completely removing auxiliary supervision.
The nonlinear orientation bit of an averaged VJP is not the expected bit over permutations; soft targets change source-gradient scale and degeneracy before bit extraction.
Native zero-support gates depend on labels and state; numerical pivot ties and near-degenerate source tangents can make bit replacements ineffective or unstable.
Row-space orthogonality precedes FP32 cast, repeated-ID sparse embedding accumulation, Adagrad and clipping; it is not parameter-update orthogonality.
Different updates change later predictions, Jacobians and true native radii; only fixed-state probes isolate the instantaneous intervention.
Current evidence uses one training seed and heavily reused validation. Deterministic replay verifies execution, not independent support. No paired-cluster intervals are available here.

trajectory_review.observation: DIN click AUC0.65554408; imported strong joint0.66845731; click-only and blocked-context both0.66785487; rolled auxiliary labels0.66746395. Local controlled evidence links benefit to auxiliary context participation at that starting point, but not a general mechanism or repeated-seed conclusion.
Single-task/reduced auxiliary paths did not beat the full joint endpoint; scale/task identity are entangled. Do not explain benefits as generic additional BCEs.

Centering/reduction and precision changed nominally similar implementations: collected-task FP32 AUC0.66745771 versus FP64 0.66829725. Numerical/collection details require bridges, not just symbolic geometry.

Native orthogonal reversal harmed AUC (0.66776576 versus0.66828874); later nuisance-line fixed-angle reversal improved it (negative0.66896107 versus positive0.66837605). Orientation effects depend on the constructed direction; a universal interference-removal explanation is unsupported.

Removing the bit nearly removed the sign gap (0.66875318 versus0.66876830); dropping fav from the bit reversed it (negative0.66832386 versus positive0.66881445). This motivates attribution of a bit source rather than further forward capacity.

Half-batch cotangent donors exactly replayed native AUC; occupied-cycle donors changed incumbent AUC by only+0.000000203. Those are weak or possibly ineffective interventions, not evidence of assignment invariance without diagnostics.

Permuting labels at recipient graph lowered negative endpoint by0.00018620 and positive endpoint by0.00002699. Native sign gap0.00058502; label-cycle sign gap0.00042581. All successful training runs; candidate_diagnostics not_requested. This retains a sign effect while leaving recipient outcome association versus injected permutation noise unresolved.

validation_plan: Before training, host imports all four modules under the frozen FeatureMap. Verify parameter/key shapes and initialization, state dicts/Dice buffers, forward probabilities and RNG parity against the r0066 native bridge; source helper/extra VJP adds no registered state.
